name: Nina Kowalski
headline: Senior Data Engineer
summary: Data engineer with 6 years building batch and streaming pipelines for retail and telecoms. I like boring, well-tested pipelines that analysts can trust on Monday morning.

experience.title: Senior Data Engineer
bullets: Run the Apache Spark platform that builds the sales and stock lake for 900 stores, about 4 TB a day on AWS.
Orchestrate 120 daily pipelines in Apache Airflow with SLAs, retries and data-quality gates.
Built a Kafka ingestion path for till events, cutting sales-data latency from a day to 15 minutes.
Wrote the SQL models behind the merchandising marts and the Python test harness that checks them.

experience.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built Spark jobs in Scala that aggregate 2 billion call-detail records a day for billing analytics.
Moved cron-scheduled scripts onto Apache Airflow, with alerting for the on-call team.
Rewrote slow SQL reports as incremental tables, cutting warehouse costs by 35%.
